$comment: The types surface of the combined catzc types assembly, a provided contract (ADR-REPO-CONTRACT-CONTRACTASSET): every public type's full name, the PSTypeAlias accelerators it declares, and the ConsoleDisplay properties that apply to it, sorted by name. It pins what a consumer binds to, never the build: the source hash that names a build is a local cache key and is not part of it. Write-TypesContract regenerates types.sample.json beside it from the compiled assembly and writes it only when the surface moves.
